Market today: The mood is cautious, especially for chip names. The real driver is the ongoing negative news surrounding Nvidia and its alleged "spy scandal," which is weighing heavily on the entire semiconductor sector. This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: Several leveraged ETFs are in deep drawdowns, amplified by margin. SOXL is down a staggering -74.05%, MUU -53.8%, and SPAL -46.16%. These "SELL" status positions, particularly the leveraged ones, demand immediate attention due to decay and margin risk.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further developments regarding Nvidia and the broader sentiment in the semiconductor space. Any continued weakness there will likely drag your book further.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions.
plays: Given "SELL" status and deep losses (-74.05% and -53.8% respectively), consider trimming or exiting SOXL and MUU to manage extreme risk from these leveraged positions.
Watch SOXS (inverse semiconductor ETF) for a potential long entry at 50.51-50.3 with a stop at 49.5, as it could benefit from continued chip sector weakness.
Review SMH, SMCI, and PLTU, all with "SELL" status and significant losses, for potential trims as negative Nvidia news impacts the broader chip sector.
